tips: Take a 5-minute break every 25–30 minutes (Pomodoro technique).
Study in a well-lit area to reduce eye strain.
Keep phones away during study blocks to improve concentration.
Snack on fruits or nuts instead of sugary foods for steady energy.
Go to bed and wake up at the same time every day, even on weekends.
Avoid caffeine after mid-afternoon.
Stop using screens at least 30 minutes before bed.
Keep your room cool, dark, and quiet for better sleep.
Fill half your plate with vegetables at main meals.
Choose water as your main drink during the day.
Eat breakfast with protein (eggs, yogurt, beans) to stay full longer.
Limit fast food to occasional treats, not daily meals.
Walk or cycle to school when safe and possible.
Stretch for 5 minutes after long periods of sitting.
Join a school sport or dance club to stay active with friends.
Aim for activities you enjoy so exercise feels fun, not like a chore.
Write down three things you are grateful for each day.
Talk to a friend, teacher, or counselor when stress builds up.
Spend time outdoors — even a short walk can improve mood.
Limit social media if it makes you feel anxious or compare yourself to others.
Stay up to date with recommended vaccinations.
Cover your mouth when coughing or sneezing, then wash hands.
Do not share water bottles, utensils, or lip balm with others.
Open windows regularly to ventilate indoor spaces.
